modified_caption: The figure presents four pie charts comparing the distribution of answer refusal categories across four language models on FACTBENCH. The 'GPT4-o' chart shows two categories, with 'Lack of Knowledge' accounting for approximately 70% and 'Safety' making up 30%. The 'Gemini1.5-Pro' chart highlights 'Misinformation' as the largest category at 45%, followed by 'Lack of Knowledge' at 20%, 'Ethical Advice' at 15%, and 'Clarification' at 10%, with 'Safety' being the smallest category at 10%. The 'Llama3.1-70B-Instruct' chart indicates 'Lack of Knowledge' as the dominant category at 80%, while 'Clarification' accounts for 20%. Finally, the 'Llama3.1-405B-Instruct' chart shows an equal distribution between 'Misinformation' and 'Lack of Knowledge,' each comprising 50%. These charts provide insights into the varying tendencies of language models to refuse answers based on different categories.

modifications.claim: 'GPT4-o' chart shows 'Lack of Knowledge' at approximately 70% and 'Safety' at 30%.
modifications.reality: The 'GPT4-o' chart shows 'Lack of Knowledge' at 83.3% and 'Safety' at 16.7%. The values are incorrect and misrepresent the proportions.

modifications.claim: The 'Gemini1.5-Pro' chart highlights 'Misinformation' as the largest category at 45%.
modifications.reality: The 'Gemini1.5-Pro' chart shows 'Misinformation' at 38.4%, not 45%. The value is exaggerated.

modifications.claim: The 'Gemini1.5-Pro' chart ranks 'Safety' and 'Clarification' equally at 10%.
modifications.reality: The 'Gemini1.5-Pro' chart shows 'Safety' at 9.3% and 'Clarification' at 14.0%. The ranking is swapped and mischaracterized.
